title: Chalcone constituents pulincisones A-F isolated from Pulicaria incisa with NQO1 inducer activity.
authors: Hamed, Ahmed R; Mohamed, Tarik A; Abdel-Halim, Sally A; El-Razek, Mohamed H Abd; El-Toumy, Sayed A; Higgins, Maureen; Skalicka-Wozniak, Krystyna; Dinkova-Kostova, Albena T; Pare, Paul W; Sakr, Mahmoud M; Hegazy, Mohamed-Elamir F
one_liner_zh: 该文从植物中分离查尔酮类化合物并测试其NQO1诱导活性，仅涉及小分子与Keap1蛋白的分子对接，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Previously unknown chalcones such as beta'-chalcanone-alpha,beta-diols and a beta-hydroxydihydrochalcone, named pulincisone A-F as well as known chalcone analogs 3,4,2',4',6',7,8-heptahydroxy-7(8)-dihydrochalcone (7) and 4,2',6'-trihydroxy-4'-methoxydihydrochalcone (8) were isolated from Pulicaria incisa (Lam.) DC. and assayed for cancer preventative activity. Structures were identified by spectroscopic methods, including HRESIMS, 1D and 2D NMR experiments. Pulincisone A and B, are epimers, at stereocenter C-8. A structural revision resulted in pulicisone A (1) and D (4) replacing pulichalconoids B and C, that were previously reported from the same species. Isolated chalcones were assessed for chemopreventive potential as inducers of NAD(P)H: quinone oxidoreductase 1 (NQO1). Compounds 2, 3, 5, and 6 induced NQO1, using a Prochaska assay. NQO1 protein expression was detected by Western blotting analysis. Compound 6 among four active compounds had the highest potency as NQO1 inducers. Molecular docking analysis of the NQO1 Keap1 Kelch domain suggests Nrf2-dependent induction. These data indicate that pulincisone F (6) is a promising bioactive antioxidant (NQO1-inducer) with superior docking scores with the Keap1-Nrf2 complex compared to the reference NQO1 inducer sulforaphane (- 8.26 versus - 5.08 kcal mol(-), respectively).
abstract_zh: 从Pulicaria incisa (Lam.) DC.中分离出先前未知的查尔酮类化合物，如beta'-查尔酮-alpha,beta-二醇和一种beta-羟基二氢查尔酮，命名为pulincisone A-F，以及已知的查尔酮类似物3,4,2',4',6',7,8-七羟基-7(8)-二氢查尔酮 (7) 和4,2',6'-三羟基-4'-甲氧基二氢查尔酮 (8)，并对其进行了癌症预防活性测定。通过光谱方法（包括HRESIMS、1D和2D NMR实验）鉴定了结构。Pulincisone A和B在立体中心C-8处为差向异构体。结构修正导致pulicisone A (1) 和D (4) 取代了先前从同一物种中报道的pulichalconoids B和C。分离的查尔酮类化合物作为NAD(P)H：醌氧化还原酶1 (NQO1) 的诱导剂，评估了其化学预防潜力。使用Prochaska测定法，化合物2、3、5和6诱导了NQO1。通过Western blotting分析检测了NQO1蛋白表达。在四种活性化合物中，化合物6作为NQO1诱导剂的效力最高。NQO1 Keap1 Kelch结构域的分子对接分析表明其具有Nrf2依赖性诱导作用。这些数据表明，pulincisone F (6) 是一种有前景的生物活性抗氧化剂（NQO1诱导剂），与参考NQO1诱导剂萝卜硫素相比，其与Keap1-Nrf2复合物的对接得分更优（分别为-8.26和-5.08 kcal mol(-)）。
